title.narrative: Digital transformation for enhanced service delivery in Samoa (TRAC II)

description.narrative: UNDP promotes people-centered digital transformation in governance, use of open digital standards, and a whole-of-government and whole-of-society approach to creating digital public infrastructure in Samoa, Niue, and the Cook Islands. While the UNDP digital readiness assessment and digital transformation strategy initiatives are enabling the governments to develop holistic, long-term blueprints for the digital transformation at the country level, they are also crucial in supporting proof of concepts to demonstrate quick wins, jumpstart progress and create momentum through the UNDP Accelerator Lab.This Initiation Plan seeks to contribute to the ongoing efforts in strengthening the CRVS Systems in Samoa and the development of the MCO’s Digital Transformation Portfolio for Enhanced Service Delivery.
